ValidationRule.description: User should not be able to edit date record if type is KYC
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Permission.Skip_Validations_Permission = FALSE, OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Key_Date_Category__c), "KYC"),ISPICKVAL(Key_Date_Category__c, "KYC")), Active__c = true, NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(AND(PRIORVALUE(Active__c) = false, Active__c = true)), OR(Name = "Due Date", Name = "Attestation Date", Name = "Due Date Override",PRIORVALUE(Name)= "Due Date", PRIORVALUE(Name)= "Attestation Date", PRIORVALUE(Name)= "Due Date Override") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The KYC date cannot be edited. Please contact your administrator if changes are required.
